$comment: Per-exam authoring contract, declared at S3 (2026-08-16). Themes A1-A7 were proposed in derivation/source-declute-serverside.md (the T1-T8 architecture starter set fits this foundational exam poorly) and are ratified here; theme_definitions carries the one-line judgment each theme exercises. pattern_extensions E01-E05 are the five mechanisms both Artefact A documents observed that the shared D01-D20 registry does not name (definitions + evidence counts in derivation/source-declute-serverside.md; caps in manifest.validation.pattern_caps). Verticals are authored fresh at S3 as AI-use-case settings - none is copied from a source scenario.

theme_definitions.A1: Capability identification — name the concept, learning paradigm, data type or application category behind a described situation
theme_definitions.A2: Service selection — pick the AWS service that performs the required job, against near neighbours that perform adjacent jobs
theme_definitions.A3: Technique selection & trade-off — choose among customization, prompting or inference approaches under a stated constraint (cost, latency, privacy, effort)
theme_definitions.A4: Measurement choice — pick the metric or evaluation approach that answers the question actually asked
theme_definitions.A5: Failure diagnosis — reason from a symptom back to the mechanism, then forward to the fix that addresses it
theme_definitions.A6: Responsible-AI judgment — fairness, transparency, sustainability, legal exposure
theme_definitions.A7: Control placement — the security or governance control that meets an obligation, at the right layer and the right time
